entities.name: ProSe relay transaction identity
entities.description: A transaction identity value allocated by the UE for the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: ProSe direct link establishment request
entities.description: A request from a 5G ProSe remote UE for establishing a secure PC5 unicast link.

entities.name: Authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay
entities.description: The procedure for authentication and key agreement between a 5G ProSe remote UE and the network via a relay UE.

entities.name: 5G ProSe remote UE
entities.description: A UE that requests establishment of a secure PC5 unicast link via a relay UE.

entities.name: Receiving ProSe direct link establishment request
entities.description: Condition triggering PRTI allocation when the UE receives a ProSe direct link establishment request from a 5G ProSe remote UE.

entities.name: Authentication procedure completion or abortion
entities.description: Condition triggering PRTI release when the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay completes or is aborted.

relations.description: Triggering condition for allocating a PRTI value.
